entries.def:
νουθετέω, -ῶ 
(νοῦς, τίθημι, hence, put in mind), [in LXX: 1Sa.3.13 (כָּהָה pi.), Job.8.1-22 (יָסַר pi., בִּין), Wis.11.10; 12.2, 26 * ;] 
to admonish, exhort: with accusative of person(s), Act.20.31, Rom.15.14, 1Co.4.14, Col.1.28; 3.16, 1Th.5.12; 5.14, 2Th.3.15.†
(AS)

νεομηνία (Att.. contr., νουμ-, Rec.), -ας, ἡ 
(νέος, μήν), [in LXX chiefly for חֹדֶשׁ ;] 
new moon: of the Jewish festival, Col.2.16.†
(AS)

νουνεχῶς 
adv. (νοῦς, ἔχω) 
sensibly, discreetly: Mrk.12.34.†
(AS)

νοῦς
(contr. from νόος), ὁ, genitive, dative, νοός, νοΐ (late forms, = cl., νοῦ, νῷ; Bl., § 9, 3), accusative, νοῦν, [in LXX chiefly for לֵב, לֵבָב ;] 
__1. prop., of the ruling faculty, mind, understanding, reason (see Lft., Notes, 88 f.; Vaughan on Rom.7.23): Luk.24.45, Rom.1.28; 7.23; 12.2; 14.5, Eph.4.17, 23 Php.4.7, 2Th.2.2, 1Ti.6.5, 2Ti.3.8, Tit.1.15, Rev.13.18; 17.9; ν. τ. σαρκός (ICC, in l), Col.2.18…

Νυμφᾶς, -ᾶ, ὁ (WH, R, mg., Νύμφα, which see), 
Nymphas: Col.4.15, R, txt. (cf. ICC, Lft., in l).†
Νύμφα (Rec., R, txt., Νυμφᾶς, which see), -ης, ἡ, Nympha (see M, Pr., 48): Col.4.15, WH, R, mg.†
(AS)

νύμφη, -ης, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for כַּלָּה ;] 
__1. cl., a bride, young wife, young woman: Mat.25.1, WH, mg., Jhn.3.29, Rev.18.23; 21.2, 9; 22.17. 
__2. As frequently in LXX (Gen.38.11, al., for כַּלָּה; 
__(a) bride; 
__(b) daughter-in-law) and in MGr. (νύφφη, νύφη), a daughter-in-law: Mat.10.35, Luk.12.53.†
(AS)

νυμφίος, -ου, ὁ
(νύμφη), [in LXX for חָתָן ;] 
a bridegroom: Mat.9.15; 25.1, 5-6; 25.10, Mrk.2.19-20, Luk.5.34-35, Jhn.2.9; 3.29, Rev.18.23.†
(AS)

νυμφών, -ῶνος, ὁ
(νύμφη), [in LXX: Tob.6.13,16* ;] 
the bride-chamber (Heb. חֻפָּה, LXX, παστός, Psa.19.5, Jol.2.16): Mat.22.10 (WE; γάμος, RV); οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ ν. (cf. cl. νυμφαγωγός, νυμφευτής), the bridegroom's friends who have charge of the nuptial arrangements: Mat.9.15, Mrk.2.19, Luk.5.34.†
(AS)

νῦν, adv., 
[in LXX chiefly for עַתָּה ;] 
__1. prop., of time, now, i.e. at the present time: as opposite to past, Jhn.4.18, Act.7.52, Rom.13.11, 2Co.7.9, Col.1.24, al.; opposite to fut., Jhn.12.27, Rom.11.31, al.; with art., ὁ (ἡ, τὸ) and subst., the present: Rom.3.26, Gal.4.25, 1Ti.6.17, Tit.2.12, al.; απὸ τοῦ ν.
